figure.title: Five records, five observation points
figure.description: A complete matrix separates period, unit, collection method, access model, direct observation, inference, and known gap across legal process, OpenAI's company report, Hugging Face host telemetry, the independent investigation, and vendor remediation.
figure.claim: The five evidence lanes answer different questions and carry different access and attribution boundaries.
figure.doesNotProve: The matrix does not rank credibility, merge incompatible units, resolve disputed interpretations, or convert allegations into findings.
transformations: Keep named units inside their source cells and do not aggregate across columns.
Preserve each source lane's terminology and attribution without assigning a score.
Render every missing or bounded detail as an explicit gap rather than an inferred absence.
figure.uncertainty: Cells summarize the reviewed source ledger. Source access and publication dates differ, and MR-2 mirrors the joint report rather than adding another investigation.
